correctness.rationale: The preimage maps are inclusion-monotone; b^{-1} either deletes 0, fixes the set, or adds 0. A nonexpanding first inverse b can be removed while preserving an expanding final preimage, contradicting minimality. Thus the first b adds 0 after a pure cyclic inverse shift, uniquely identifying ba^j from the first 01 boundary. Prefix pattern counting proves the exact histogram and all n-1 stuck initial segments. The independently implemented inverse-subset BFS (n=2..13) and forward word enumeration including uniqueness (n=2..8) both passed.

value.rationale: The 2026 extending-word certificate literature explicitly identifies the exact worst-case Černý family as a barrier to a uniform n-1 bound but gives only a finite example and existential all-n obstruction. This theorem solves a natural comprehensive classification: individual shortest witnesses, full threshold distribution, exact exceptions and a limiting mean, for every subset and every n. It explains mathematically why worst-case slow reset coexists with exponentially rare hard one-step extensions. The proof is structural and a complete classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
